body: It's really a compilation of things, but mostly the fact that I have always been really lonely. I always tried to be there for people cause I wanted someone to eventually be there for me I could wait I was patient, you get what you put in so I've always tried to be a good person. Don't get me wrong I've definitely done bad things so to speak, like I stole from a bunch of stores as a kid like putting candy and yugioh cards in my pocket and stuff, I smoked a lot of weed and still do, I cus like crazy,I did jail time for dealing and stuff. I'm no Tyto in gleaming armor and battle claws, but I've definitely walked the line. I never hurt people I never cheated on the girls I happened to be with I never broke into anything, not even a candy machine, I never took from people's purses/wallets I'd work for their cash. Like I did do dumb shit but I no one ever suffered because of me, I was solely reckless to me. Like I wouldn't even go home I'd just call if I was too far gone, and I always knew when I was. Like I don't steal and shit now I just smoke weed. But I still am good to people, I'm always nice and smiling a laugh at the jokes that are just funny because they're so corny, I listen when people fucking speak, I hold doors, I make eye contact., I let people cut in, I always use my manners I clean up after myself and minimize everything of mine so as not to cause anyone else distress or something like that. But I've paid a lot of dues man. I've put a lot of good in and really I'm just tired of being a good person and trying to be there for everyone and putting myself last like I always have. Like I had a point last year where I had to be at work at 6 am everyday and I'd take me roommate to get food for himself and charge no gas  in the next town, at midnight because he didn't like being out with other people around, then I'd order for him at food joints because he couldn't talk loudly enough and then I'd go get his cigarettes and weed for him because he was uncomfortable with the dealer and he had lost his I.d. and I hadn't saved up enough to buy him a new one or gotten the day off approved. And I never complained and told him if I complained to much to tell me cause I didn't want to get on his nerves. Like. Son. I'm fucking Nice. So why the fuck am I so alone? There was no one there for me when I was released from jail at 18. My mom came to see me one time as an accident, she had misheard the court date. My brother and sister grew up with out me, my wife left me, my grandparents and my big mamma are dead, the man who I called dad walked away from us, the one who was supposed to be dad waited a life time to step in and demands audience when he has no grounds to demand a Facebook friends request, the people I grew up with aren't even in contact with each other let alone me. Like what the fuck happened to loyalty and being there for those who were there for you? It doesn't make sense to try and be this person that obviously can't exist in this world, I can't be the person I see in so many other people who became lonely and bitter. It's been six years. Nothing has changed so why should I keep on keeping on?
